EntryTitle: Augmented Monthly SST and SST Gradient Statistics on a 1-Degree Global Grid from AQUA MODIS (URI-GSO)
Abstract: Monthly statistics of sea surface temperature (SST) and SST spatial gradients derived from NASA AQUA MODIS Level-2 satellite retrievals, binned onto a 1-degree global grid. Each file contains sufficient statistics (pixel counts, sums, and sums of squares) to compute the mean, variance, and standard deviation of SST and several gradient quantities within each grid cell for a given calendar month. Gradients are provided in two coordinate frames: geographic (eastward, northward) and satellite (along-swath, across-track), plus gradient magnitudes. Daytime and nighttime satellite passes are tracked independently. The gradient computation uses a spatial kernel of approximately 4-6 km, appropriate for resolving mesoscale oceanographic fronts. The dataset spans July 2002 through December 2024, covering 23 years of the AQUA mission. Data are stored as NetCDF files with 34 variables on a 360 x 180 (longitude x latitude) grid with cell centers from -179.5 to 179.5 degrees East and -89.5 to 89.5 degrees North. The 'augmented' designation indicates enrichment with satellite-frame gradient statistics beyond the original geographic-frame statistics. These data support research on the spatial and temporal variability of ocean thermal fronts.
Purpose: To provide a global climatology of SST gradient statistics for studying the distribution, intensity, and temporal variability of ocean thermal fronts derived from satellite SST observations.

ProcessingLevel.ProcessingLevelDescription: Gridded monthly statistics derived from Level-2 MODIS AQUA SST orbit data. Processing includes quality masking (Fix_MODIS_Mask), gradient computation over approximately 4-6 km spatial scale in geographic and satellite reference frames, binning to a 1-degree global grid, and monthly accumulation of sums, sums of squares, and pixel counts.
